reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5 — proved the related rail was identical on every volleyball photo, then fixed the tiering
method: Measured against production data rather than read from code. Before: two photos from different albums (rbxw3h, 1BlKk4) returned byte-identical 'related' lists, all twelve from a third album, under a heading reading 'More from this Album & Sport' — because the .or() third branch subsumed the second and a global ORDER BY upload_date drowned the album branch, with sport_type=volleyball matching 15,330 of 21,743 rows. After: rbxw3h, 1BlKk4 and pHqw25 each return twelve distinct photos drawn only from their own album, with the current photo excluded by photo_id. 260 of 262 albums hold twelve or more photos so tier one fills the rail in a single query; the two that do not (5 and 7 photos) fall through to sport+category then sport. Also removed the 'Visually Similar Photos' carousel: PHOTO_COLUMNS excludes the embedding by design, so its guard short-circuited on every request and the section had never rendered for any visitor — no visible change, and the match_photos RPC and embeddings remain in use by search.
